## Overview

- [Feature availability](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview.md): The Availability column in each of the following tables lists the platforms that offer a feature.
- [Message Batches API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing.md): The Message Batches API is a powerful, cost-effective way to asynchronously process large volumes of [Messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages/create) requests.
- [Set up the loop](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-effort-example.md): The example is a single file. The constants control the effort level, the fan-out shape, and how often the mode refresher is re-sent.
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics.md): When the beta header is present, the API stores a lightweight fingerprint of each request, keyed by the response `id`.
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/citations.md): Integrate citations with Claude in these steps:
- [Access](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-amazon-bedrock.md): Amazon Bedrock sets access criteria for each Claude model individually.
- [Hosting options](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry.md): Claude models in Microsoft Foundry are available in two hosting options. You choose the hosting option when you configure the deployment.
- [Install and configure the AWS CLI](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-on-amazon-bedrock-legacy.md): 1. [Install a version of the AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-chap-welcome.html) at or newer than version `2.13.23`.

- [How the platform integration works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws.md): Claude models run on Anthropic-managed infrastructure. This is a commercial integration for billing and access through AWS.

- [How the context window works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md): The "context window" refers to all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.
- [How Claude resizes and pads images](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision-coordinates.md): Claude finds the largest aspect-preserving size that satisfies both of the model's image limits: 1.
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort.md): By default, Claude uses high effort, spending as many tokens as needed for excellent results.

- [Supported models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode.md): Fast mode is supported on the following models: * Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5) * Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8)
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files.md): Referencing a `file_id` in a Messages request is supported on all models that support the given file type.

- [Overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/multilingual-support.md): Claude demonstrates robust multilingual capabilities, with particularly strong performance in zero-shot tasks across languages.
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support.md): Claude works with any standard PDF. Ensure your request size meets these requirements:

- [How Claude decides when to think](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-steering-and-cost.md): Thinking is optional for the model. On each request, Claude weighs the complexity of the input and decides whether deeper reasoning would improve the answer.
- [Quick reference](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons.md): The `stop_reason` field is part of every successful Messages API response.
- [Streaming with SDKs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/streaming.md): The [Python SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python) and [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript) offer multiple ways of streaming.
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs.md): Without structured outputs, Claude can generate malformed JSON responses or invalid tool inputs that break your applications.
- [Compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/task-budgets.md): Task budgets work best for agentic workflows where Claude makes multiple tool calls and decisions before finalizing its output to await the next human response.
- [How thinking works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking.md): Whether Claude thinks on a given request, and how deeply, depends on your thinking configuration and the complexity of the request.

- [Configurations each model rejects](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting.md): Most thinking configuration errors are a mismatch between the `thinking.type` value in the request and what the model supports.

- [Basic request and response](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/working-with-messages.md): The `temperature`, `top_p`, and `top_k` sampling parameters are not supported on Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview.
- [Send images to Claude](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision.md): Use Claude's vision capabilities through: * [claude.ai](https://claude.ai/). Upload an image like you would a file, or drag and drop an image directly into the chat window.
